scripts.verify: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run -w @zerofee/web build
scripts.build:contracts: for c in recovery-policy; do (cd contracts/$c && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo" && mkdir -p res && cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/near/$(echo $c | tr - _).wasm" res/) || exit 1; done && npm run -s build:account-policy
scripts.build:account-policy: cd contracts/account-policy && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --no-abi --no-default-features --features agent --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/src --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$PWD/target}=/build" && mkdir -p res release && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --strip-debug --strip-producers "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/near/account_policy.wasm" -o release/account_policy-10.wasm && npm run -s build:account-policy:short-waits && (cd release && shasum -a 256 account_policy-10.wasm account_policy-10-short-waits.wasm > SHA256SUMS-10)
scripts.test:contract: cd contracts/account-policy && cargo test && cargo test --no-default-features --features agent --lib r7_release_minimum
scripts.build:account-policy:short-waits: cd contracts/account-policy && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --no-abi --features short-waits,agent --env "RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-s --remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/src --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$PWD/target}=/build" && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --strip-debug --strip-producers "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/near/account_policy.wasm" -o release/account_policy-10-short-waits.wasm
scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath tools/hooks && echo 'Commit hooks: tools/hooks (UTC, ZeroFee identity, .git/info/leak-patterns, signing and env files, secret shapes).'
